elements.label: About
elements.value: Instant burst movement in the character's facing direction with configurable distance and cooldown.

onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_c_dir to {{da_c_dir}}]
Set the dash direction mode to {{da_c_dir}} for the Dash ability.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_c_power to {{da_c_power}}]
Set dash power preset to {{da_c_power}} for the Dash ability. Short=3m, Standard=5m, Long=8m.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_t_distance to {{da_t_distance}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDistance to {{da_t_distance}} world units.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_t_duration to {{da_t_duration}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDuration to {{da_t_duration}} seconds.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/abilities/properties/dash.schema.json, set da_t_cooldown to {{da_t_cooldown}}]
Set DashAbility.dashCooldown to {{da_t_cooldown}} seconds.
